aka: St. George's Church, Barton in Fabis
36394.cat: St George's church, Barton in Fabis

stories.text: A church was built here in the 14th century. Altered over the centuries, it was restored in 1877 and 1885, and it is listed Grade I.

36394.sum: St George's Church is a parish church in the Church of England in Barton in Fabis, Nottinghamshire.

stories.text: In 1677 an octagonal red-brick dovecote was built at Manor Farm. It is listed Grade II.
